description:
Please check out our new website at www.so-living.ie for a full selection of available apartments and virtual tours.

Só Living offers stunning 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments in the heart of Dublin City Centre.
All apartments come fully furnished with custom designed interiors and a wide range of on-site services including fully equipped residents only gym, business centre and recreation room. All internal finishes are of the highest quality and the facilities we offer are second to none.

Só Living provides a rental service of the highest quality through our on-site management office. Our dedicated team are available to make your rental and living experience with Só Living as seamless and as comfortable as possible. Through our parcel collection service, on-site dry cleaning and boardroom/ study room rental, we aim to provide the services that you really need.

Cathedral Court is situated on New Street South, in the heart of Dublin's creative quarter and a two minute walk from St. Patrick's Cathedral. No matter where you need to be in Dublin City, our central locations mean your Só Living development is never too far away.

To fully appreciate the uniqueness of what we offer, viewing is highly advised. Contact a member of our team today to arrange a personal viewing and see for yourself!
